exam_metadata.title: CIS - Data Foundations (CMDB & CSDM) - 2
exam_metadata.note: Questions are numbered as shown in the exam. Some numbers are missing in the source (e.g. 46) and are preserved as-is.
exam_metadata.verification: Answer key verified against official ServiceNow product documentation (Australia, Zurich and Yokohama releases) on 2026-11-05.

questions.question: A CMDB Architect intends to build a CMDB using CSDM guidance. Which CMDB tables will the architect use to build the CSDM sell/consume domain?

choices.text: Business Capability, Information Object, Business Application
Application Service, Technology Management Service (Technical Service), Technology Management Offering (Technical Service Offering)

questions.explanation: The Service Consumption (Sell/Consume) domain holds Business Services, Business Service Offerings and the request catalog. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/sell-consume-domain.html

questions.question: Drag and drop the application service type to the best description.

targets.label: Recommended for mission-critical applications that require a precise approach using patterns
Best fit to map cloud-native, container-based, or virtual machine environments

questions.explanation: Top-down (pattern-based) mapping gives a high-fidelity map for mission-critical services; tag-based mapping fits cloud, container and VM environments using cloud tags; ML connection suggestions use fingerprinting for custom-built apps; Dynamic CI groups fit small services defined by a CMDB query. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/application-services.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator would like to minimize stale CIs in the CMDB. Which CMDB Health Dashboard scorecard displays this information?
questions.explanation: Duplicate, Orphan and Stale CIs are the Correctness metrics. Completeness covers required and recommended fields, and Compliance covers audits against certification templates. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A CMDB Data Owner has requested better insights on the different data sources that make up the CMDB data set. The Platform Owner knows that the new Service Graph Connector Central plugin is just what is needed. After installing the plugin, what workspace will have the new Service Graph Connector Central tab available?
questions.explanation: After SGC Central is installed, its view appears in CMDB Workspace (and Service Graph Workspace). There is no 'Service Graph Connector Workspace'. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/sgcc-landing.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager needs to enable a CMDB Data Manager policy to remove records from a CI Class while retaining the ability to restore them within a specified period. Which policy type should the Configuration Manager create?
questions.explanation: Archive moves CIs into archive tables for a configurable retention period, during which they can be restored. Delete is irreversible. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is asked to clean up the CMDB duplicates. What is the preferred way to manage this task?

choices.text: My Tasks in the Application Navigator
The de-duplication dashboard on the CMDB workspace

questions.explanation: The De-duplication dashboard in CMDB Workspace is the central place for remediating de-duplication tasks, including running templates in bulk. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/dedup-ci-exp-cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: A Business Relationship Manager in an organization wants to implement Service Portfolio Management (SPM) and to present offerings to business consumers. Which CSDM Domain does this align with?
questions.explanation: Presenting offerings to business consumers (Service Portfolio Management) is the Service Consumption (Sell/Consume) domain. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/sell-consume-domain.html

questions.question: A Service Owner needs to view related items, such as Active Incidents and Planned Changes, directly on the home node of the Unified Map. Which work area would allow the Service Owner to meet this goal?
questions.explanation: The Related items panel (part of the contextual side panel) shows changes, active incidents and active problems for the selected CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/unified-map/cmdb-workspace-unified-map.html

questions.question: Which are CMDB Data Manager end of life policy types?
questions.explanation: The life-cycle (end-of-life) policies are Retire, Archive and Delete; they require an active retirement definition for each targeted class. Lost, Decommission and Disposed are status values, not policy types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-manager-create-policy-wrkspc.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to leverage the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard. What are benefits of using this application?

choices.text: Has a framework to create custom metrics for the CMDB
Checks that important data is valid and properly configured
Provides playbooks to assist in the remediation of potential risks
Uses automation to remediate potential risks

questions.explanation: The CMDB Data Foundations dashboard checks that important data is valid and properly configured, and each metric links to a remediation playbook. It does not auto-remediate and has no custom-metric framework. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A CMDB Configuration Manager intends to implement CMDB Data Manager delete and archive policies for all server records in the New York datacenter. In which lifecycle state would servers be affected by these new policies?
questions.explanation: Archive and Delete policies only process CIs that are already retired according to their class retirement definition - by CSDM default, Life Cycle Stage = End of Life and Life Cycle Stage Status = Retired. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/life-cycle-rules.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager wants to explore ServiceNow CMDB 360 saved queries to see if the reports can assist with managing of CMDB data. What insights are gained from CMDB 360 queries?

choices.text: Unique CIs created from different data sources
Gaps in attribute data from different data sources
Different attribute values from different data sources
Orphan CIs created from different data sources
Duplicate configuration items from different data sources

questions.explanation: CMDB 360 queries find gaps (CIs or attributes reported by one source but not another) and compare attribute values that differ across discovery sources. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb360-exp-cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: The CMDB Configuration Management team wants to manage de-duplication tasks generated from data ingested into the CMDB via the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE). In which area of the CMDB Workspace can they locate these de-duplication tasks?

choices.text: Total status tile under the My Work tab
CMDB feature adoption tile under the Insights tab
Important actions tile under the Home tab

questions.explanation: De-duplication tasks generated by the IRE appear as cards in the Important actions tile on the CMDB Workspace Home view, which link to the De-duplication dashboard and template libraries. My Work holds CMDB Data Manager tasks. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-workspace-home-view.html

questions.question: An organization needs to maintain non-discoverable attributes, such as warranty expiration dates, for hardware CIs. These attributes are not updated by automated discovery tools. What method ensures these attributes are accurately maintained for all CIs?

choices.text: Use a scheduled data import to update the attributes from an external source
Create a new CI class specifically for non-discoverable attributes
Use the CMDB Reconciliation Engine to update the attributes

questions.explanation: Data that discovery can't see should come from its authoritative source through a scheduled import. Reconciliation only decides which source may update an attribute. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/c_OptionsToPopulateCMDB.html

questions.question: A Manager needs information on how to correctly establish relationships between Infrastructure CIs, Technology Management Offerings (Technical Service Offerings), and Application Services within the CMDB. Which CSDM domain would provide this information?
questions.explanation: Service Delivery (Manage Technical Services) covers Technology Management Offerings, service instances (application services), Dynamic CI groups and Application Runs on::Runs infrastructure CIs. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/manage-tech-servs-domain.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator seeks to understand the available tools for preventing, addressing, and remediating duplicate CIs. Drag and drop each feature with the corresponding outcome.

targets.label: Can be assigned to groups for resolving duplicate CIs
Offers insight into duplicate CIs within the CMDB
Offers a solution to resolve de-duplication tasks in bulk
Provides a wizard to resolve de-duplication tasks individually

questions.explanation: De-duplication tasks can be assigned to groups; the CMDB Health Dashboard's Duplicate metric gives insight into duplicates; templates resolve tasks in bulk; the Duplicate CI Remediator wizard resolves a single task. Certification tasks don't apply. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/de-duplication-tasks.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator uses the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard to gain insights into the CMDB. The results display low scores for several metrics. Which actions can the CMDB Administrator take to improve the CMDB Health?

choices.text: Use the Remediation Playbooks linked beside each metric
Focus on metric(s) with Critical and High priorities
Adjust the metrics using exclusion rules to improve the scores

questions.explanation: Metrics are listed in priority order (1 - Critical first) and each has a remediation playbook link, so focus on critical/high metrics and follow their playbooks. There are no exclusion rules for tuning the scores. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs the fastest time to value solution for effectively ingesting, managing, and maintaining CIs and relationships. Which management tool will accomplish this to import Windows computer data from SCCM?

choices.text: Import set using JDBC data source connection to SCCM using transform maps
IntegrationHub ETL connection to SCCM using Robust Transform Engine (RTE)

questions.explanation: Service Graph Connectors are certified, pre-built integrations (here for Microsoft SCCM) that minimize customization and accelerate time to value, and they process data through the IRE. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-sgc-intro.html

questions.question: An organization is updating the CMDB to include new asset types like IoT devices. Relevant CI classes need to be added and outdated ones need to be removed from the Principal Class filter to ensure accurate display in ITSM processes. Which roles are needed to add or remove classes?
questions.explanation: Updating the Principal Class filter requires sn_cmdb_admin (or itil_admin) plus personalize_dictionary, because it edits class (dictionary) metadata. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/update-principal-class-filter.html

questions.question: A Configuration Management team wants to confirm that all servers in the CMDB are correctly associated with their location. Which CMDB Data Manager policy type does the team create?
questions.explanation: Location is a CI attribute. Certification policies validate that specific attributes have the expected values; Attestation only confirms the CI exists. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: The Server [cmdb_ci_server] class uses a dynamic reconciliation rule of lowest value for the Disk Space (GB) field, while the Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] class uses a dynamic reconciliation rule of most reported for the Disk Space (GB) field. Given the following data sources that populate Windows Server data into the CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB: Tivoli=75, ServiceNow=75, LANDesk=50, Altiris=80. Which value would be added to the CMDB for the Disk Space (GB) field of a Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] record?
questions.explanation: A child-class reconciliation rule overrides the parent's rule, so the Windows Server rule (most reported) applies: 75 is reported by two sources. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_ReconciliationRulesPrinciples.html

questions.question: An Asset Manager wants to ensure that Asset records and CI records are kept synchronized automatically. How does the Manager do this?

choices.text: Ensure one-to-one physical mapping between Asset and CI
Ensure that the business rule to update Asset fields on change on the CI table is active
Ensure that scheduled jobs are run during off-business hours to ensure that sync happens
Ensure that the business rule to update CI fields on change on the asset table is active

questions.explanation: Asset and CI records stay synchronized through two base-system business rules: 'Update CI fields on change' on alm_asset and 'Update Asset fields on change' on cmdb_ci. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-asset-management/asset-management/c_ManagingAssets.html

questions.question: User endpoint devices are imported into the CMDB and populate the 'Assigned to' [assigned_to] field on the Computer [cmdb_ci_computer] CI. The Asset team puts in a request for the Configuration Analysts to populate the 'Assigned to' field on the related Asset. What action does a Configuration Analyst take to achieve this in an automated way?

choices.text: Use the Asset-CI Field Mapping module to create a new rule to replicate the 'Assigned to' value between the asset and associated CI
Configure a business rule on the computer table to use a script to populate the 'Assigned to' field on the asset based on insert or update in the computer class 'Assigned to' field
Hide the 'Assigned to' field on the asset record and create a new field that dot walks to the related CI to get the 'Assigned to' value

questions.explanation: Asset-CI Field Mapping (Asset > Administration > Asset-CI Field Mapping) is the supported, no-code way to keep a field synchronized both ways between an asset and its CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-asset-management/asset-management/t_CreateAssetandCIFieldsMapping.html

questions.question: A retail organization needs to ensure that incidents affecting customer-facing services are resolved quickly to reduce potential revenue loss. Which CSDM attribute is used to prioritize these services?

choices.text: Assignment Group on the CI record
Affected CIs in the Incident record
Service classification in the Technical Service
Business Criticality in the Service Offering

questions.explanation: Business criticality is set per service offering, so incidents on customer-facing offerings can be prioritized. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-service-management/change-management/itsm-change-use-case-example.html

questions.question: The Change Management team in an organization wants to implement a Change across multiple CIs at the same time. Which field on the Change Request form needs to be populated with a dynamic CI group?
questions.explanation: A Dynamic CI group can be used as a group CI in the Configuration Item field of a change, so one change covers all its member CIs. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-dynamic-ci-groups-by-service.html

questions.question: A company wants to track regulatory compliance. ServiceNow has an artifact type called an information object as part of the CSDM framework. What is the purpose of an information object?

choices.text: It describes data in general on a group of Configuration Items.
It describes the logical data to the Business Applications.
It describes data exchanged between an API interface and an Application.

questions.explanation: Regulated data (PII, PCI DSS, HIPAA...) is modeled as Information Objects related to the Business Application (Business application Uses::Used by Information object) in the Design & Planning domain. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/design-domain.html

questions.question: Where can an administrator perform Natural Language Queries (NLQ)?
questions.explanation: CMDB Workspace's search and explore view supports Natural Language Query (NLQ) through Intelligent Search for CMDB. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/sg-workspace-search-explore-view.html

questions.question: The following identification rule for a CI class has been defined: Hardware Rule (Identifier Entries Table) - Serial Number (serial_number, serial_number_type) priority 100; Hardware (serial_number) priority 200; Hardware (name) priority 300; Network Adapter (mac_address, name) priority 400. Two new CI records are imported into the hardware class of the CMDB: CI1: The name of this CI record matches the name of an existing CI record in the CMDB. CI2: The IP address of this CI record matches the IP address of an existing CI record in the CMDB. Which is correct based on the identification rule and the imported CI records?

choices.text: CI1 will be updated with matching record and CI2 will be inserted as new record.
CI1 and CI2 both will be inserted as new records.

questions.explanation: CI1 matches an existing CI on Name, which is an identifier entry, so it is updated. IP address is not a criterion attribute in the rule, so CI2 matches nothing and is inserted as a new CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/class-hardware.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is working in the CI Class Manager on the Basic Info tab. How can the class be set as a Principal Class?

choices.text: Click the Principal Class UI Action button
Check the Principal Class check box
Select 'Yes' from the Principal Class choice list

questions.explanation: Select the Principal Class check box in CI Class Manager > Class Info > Basic Info. CI reference fields on the task types in the principal-class filter property (incident, problem, change and their tasks) then show only CIs from principal classes. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/update-principal-class-filter.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager is implementing end to end service modeling and wants to get help on status and playbooks for improving the quality. What does the Configuration Manager reference to obtain guidance?
questions.explanation: The CSDM Data Foundations dashboard shows key CSDM indicators per implementation stage (Foundation, Crawl, Walk, Run, Fly) and links to playbooks for remediation. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/csdm-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: The Incident Process Owner asks which classes of CSDM are used on the Incident form. Which classes are appropriate?
questions.explanation: The incident form uses Service, Service Offering and Configuration Item (which can be an application service). Business Applications aren't used by Incident, Problem or Change. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-implement-crawl-stage.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to configure a new application identification rule that considers the potential for the same application installed more than once on the same server. Which is the best choice of a criterion attribute?
questions.explanation: Two installs of the same application on one server share Class, Version and often the configuration file name; only the full configuration file path (install location) tells them apart.

questions.question: Where can a CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB Saved Query be viewed and created in the CMDB Workspace?

choices.text: Coverage window on the CMDB 360 tab
Saved queries window on the CMDB 360 tab
Saved queries window on the Insights tab

questions.explanation: The Saved queries card on the CMDB 360 tab of CMDB Workspace lists your CMDB 360 queries; from there you can run and edit them or create new ones. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb360-exp-cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: A CMDB CI Class Owner responsible for the Windows Servers needs to manage the Windows Server class. Which CI Class Manager feature will help the CI Class Owner streamline this task?
questions.explanation: Pinned Classes in CI Class Manager give quick navigation back to the classes you use most. Source: ServiceNow University course 'CMDB Fundamentals' (Australia)

questions.question: A Configuration Management Governance team is transitioning from utilizing legacy CMDB status fields to CSDM life cycle status fields. Which table can be modified?
questions.explanation: Only the Life Cycle Mapping [life_cycle_mapping] rules (legacy status -> CSDM stage/status pair) are meant to be updated. Life Cycle Stage, Stage Status and Control hold the ServiceNow-owned standard values and valid combinations. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-life-cycle-standard-values.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to prevent duplicate CI creation from import sets that load data into the CMDB from vendor shipment files containing CI information. How can the Administrator do this?

choices.text: Create comparison rules in the IRE
Use the CMDBTransformUtil API in the transform script
Set the system property to utilize the IRE within transform maps
Set the coalesce on two mappings within the transform map

questions.explanation: Coalescing only matches within the transform map and bypasses the IRE. ServiceNow's documented method is to call the CMDBTransformUtil API from an onBefore transform script so each row is identified by the IRE before insert. There is no system property that turns the IRE on for transform maps. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/identification-import-sets.html

questions.question: The CMDB Health Dashboard is based on three Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Correctness, Compliance, and Completeness. Each KPI includes several sub-metrics. Drag the sub-metrics to the KPI.

targets.label: Completeness
Compliance
Correctness

questions.explanation: Completeness: Required (and Recommended) fields; Compliance: Audit; Correctness: Orphan (and Duplicate, Stale). Stability, Certify and Suggested are not health sub-metrics. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to set up CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB. Drag and drop the system property to the functionality.

items.text: Enables capturing CMDB 360 data for CIs from non-CMDB classes
Enables capturing CMDB 360 data for CIs from CMDB classes
Maximum number of CIs that can be included in a CMDB 360 recompute operation

targets.label: glide.identification_engine.multisource_enabled
glide.identification_engine.multisource_cmdb_ci_enabled
glide.cmdb.logger.source.cmdb_multisource
glide.identification_engine.multisource.recompute.max.ci.limit

questions.explanation: multisource_enabled enables CMDB 360; multisource_cmdb_ci_enabled captures CMDB 360 data for CMDB classes (non-CMDB classes have their own property, so that item is the distractor); glide.cmdb.logger.source.cmdb_multisource enables logging; recompute.max.ci.limit caps a recompute. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/components-multisource-cmdb.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator notices that CIs do not have a support group. How can the support group be automatically populated and maintained on the CI record?

choices.text: Technology Management Service Offering (Technical Service Offering)

questions.explanation: Set Support group, Change group or Managed by group on a Technology Management Offering linked to a Dynamic CI Group and the values are applied to all its CIs. Approval, CMDB and Owned by groups are not synced. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-enable-tso.html

questions.question: Where does a user with the appropriate role(s) review and manage the generated tasks after configuring CMDB Data Manager policies?

choices.text: CMDB Health Dashboard > Duplicate CIs tab

questions.explanation: Data Manager tasks (attestation, certification, life-cycle approvals) are reviewed in CMDB Workspace > My Work (renamed the 'Tasks' view in newer releases). The Management view is where policies are created and tracked. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-manager-review-task-wrkspc.html

questions.question: A global enterprise integrates data from multiple discovery sources such as ServiceNow Discovery, SCCM, AWS, and manual uploads to populate its CMDB. However, each discovery source categorizes the same CIs differently, leading to duplicate records and inconsistencies across the system. As a result, the CMDB team is struggling with data accuracy and standardization. What actions does the CMDB team take to resolve the issue?

choices.text: Use CI Class Manager to establish standardized CI classes and attributes across all discovery sources
Allow each discovery source to define its own CI class, even if it results in inconsistencies
Implement and use identification and reconciliation rules to avoid duplicates and standardize CI classification
Create a custom script to manually adjust incoming data before storing it in the CMDB

questions.explanation: Standardize classes and attributes in CI Class Manager, and let IRE identification and reconciliation rules prevent duplicates and decide which source may update which attribute. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/c_CMDBIdentifyandReconcile.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager working in the CMDB Workspace wants to see how CIs are connected to each other. Which tool can be used?
questions.explanation: Unified Map is the CMDB Workspace tool that graphically shows CIs, the relationships between them and application services. 'Relationship Map' isn't a CMDB Workspace feature. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-workspace-home-view.html

questions.question: A CMDB team has noticed that some hardware CIs are missing the serial number information, making it difficult to maintain data accuracy. The team needs a structured approach to identify and address these gaps. Which accomplishes this task?
questions.explanation: 'Hardware CIs with Serial Numbers' is a CMDB Data Foundations dashboard metric with its own remediation playbook, which gives a structured way to analyze and fix the gap. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A ServiceNow Administrator wants to implement Service Graph Connectors to provide integrations to many third-party solutions that the company wants integrated into the CMDB. Which categories of connectors are available to the Administrator?
questions.explanation: SGC categories include public cloud providers, endpoint/IT asset management, monitoring and observability, security, software/server/network and operational technology. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/service-graph-connectors/cmdb-sgc-available.html

questions.question: Using CI Class Manager, the Tomcat identification rule has the following criterion attributes configured: Class, Install Directory. Which identifier entry configuration option must be checked to attempt a match using the Application identification rule if no match is found using the Tomcat identification rule?
questions.explanation: 'Allow fallback to parent's rules' lets the IRE use the parent class's identification rule (here Application) when no match is found with the dependent child rule (Tomcat). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_CreateCIIdentificationRule.html

questions.question: Drag and drop the product to its description.

targets.label: Automatically identifies devices and applications in the network, populating the CMDB with accurate and up-to-date information
Facilitates integration between ServiceNow and external systems to import and synchronize data
Complete topology of the services and shows how they are supported by underlying infrastructure and applications
Provides real-time visibility into endpoint configurations, populating the CMDB with accurate and up-to-date information

questions.explanation: Discovery scans and identifies infrastructure; Service Graph Connectors integrate external systems; Service Mapping builds the service topology; Agent Client Collector is an agent on endpoints giving real-time configuration visibility. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-operations-management/discovery/r-discovery.html

questions.question: A Configuration Management team needs to prevent duplicate server records to avoid confusion among users. Server records are identified when they are processed via the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) using the configured identification rules. Where would these rules be configured?
questions.explanation: Identification rules are configured per class in CI Class Manager (Class Info > Identification Rule) and are applied by the IRE. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_CreateCIIdentificationRule.html

questions.question: The CMDB Administrator has been asked to establish Configuration Management with a functional CMDB. Which factor is most critical for successfully operationalizing the CMDB in ServiceNow?

choices.text: Establishing clear governance and continuously monitoring CMDB health
Relying on automated discovery tools to maintain and update CMDB records
Populating the CMDB with as much data as possible to ensure a comprehensive inventory of CIs
Allowing IT teams to modify CMDB records as needed to promote flexibility in data management

questions.explanation: Data in the model has little value without governance and an effective process to keep it true and valid, continuously monitored through CMDB health. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-landing-page.html

questions.question: A Configuration Management Process Owner needs to configure Data Manager for policy tasks to be correctly assigned and aligned with the group attribute assigned to a class in CI Class Manager. Which is the recommended field to be used for a policy task assignment?
questions.explanation: CI Class Manager sets the Managed By Group for a whole class, and Data Manager creates/approves tasks per Managed By Group value - so Managed By Group is the field that aligns policy tasks with class ownership. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-data-synchronize-enable.html

questions.question: A CMDB CI Class Owner has been asked to change the icon for the UNIX Server class. Which CI Class Manager tab can the owner use to change the icon for the class?
questions.explanation: The class icon is part of the class definition on CI Class Manager's Basic Info tab. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_ViewTableDefinitions.html

questions.question: An organization is using CMDB Query Builder to find all application services with a database that has incidents and all infrastructure in those application services. Which steps does the organization take to build this query?

choices.text: Add a non-CMDB table to the query
Use a Service Mapping Query to include non-CMDB tables like the Incident table
Use a Service Mapping Query to find all incidents related to the database
Use a CMDB Query to include application services and their related infrastructure

questions.explanation: Build one CMDB query: include the application services and their related infrastructure, and add Incident from the Non-CMDB Tables list. Service Mapping queries only match CI-class patterns and can't include non-CMDB tables. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/querying-cmdb.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has installed a Service Graph Connector (SGC), and then made customizations to the mappings. Which is a consequence of this action?

choices.text: The customized mappings are not supported by ServiceNow, and the customer is responsible for supporting their own customized SGC.
The customization will prevent the SGC from executing without an approval record attached to the affected mapping record.
Fields populated by a customization will have a special tag associated with them in the CMDB.

questions.explanation: Once you customize an SGC's mappings you own them: upgrades skip your customized files and the customer must maintain/support them. There are no special field tags or approval records for customizations. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/service-graph-connectors/upgrade-sccm-newer-version.html

questions.question: Which ServiceNow solutions automatically create relationships between CI Applications that are part of an Application Service?
questions.explanation: Discovery creates relationships from the TCP connections it finds, and Service Mapping builds the full map of CIs in an application service; both create relationships automatically. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-operations-management/discovery/r_ApplicationDependencyMapping.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager responsible for a specific region wants to use the CMDB Health Dashboard to improve the data quality of the CMDB for that region. The Configuration Manager only sees the overall score and grouped by CI Class. How can the Configuration Manager get a score for regionally relevant CIs?

choices.text: Create CMDB groups with type, health, by region
Customize the CMDB Health Dashboard scheduled jobs to group the results by region
On the CMDB health settings, activate the option, Group scores by region

questions.explanation: Create CMDB groups of type Health (e.g. one per region). CMDB Health then monitors and scores just the CIs in that group, for example only CIs in a specific location. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-groups.html

questions.question: The CMDB Administrator group seeks to filter specific CI classes that display on the CMDB Health Dashboard. This ensures that only relevant data is displayed, excluding items that are not ready for management. Which feature can the group utilize to achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: Health inclusion rules filter which CIs are included in health calculations and shown on the CMDB Health Dashboard, e.g. to leave out classes not yet ready for management. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-health-inclusion-rule.html

questions.question: ServiceNow provides a suite of CMDB management tools designed to effectively ingest, manage, and maintain CIs and relationships. Drag and drop the design architecture to its management tool.

items.text: Pre-built store integration solutions that require minimal customization

targets.label: Agent Client Collector
Import Sets
Service Graph Connector
ServiceNow Discovery

questions.explanation: Agent Client Collector = agent-based, running patterns; Discovery = agentless, running patterns; Import Sets = organization-built using transform maps; Service Graph Connectors = pre-built Store integrations that minimize customization. 'Third-party integrations from other vendors' is the distractor. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-sgc-intro.html

questions.question: Which shows the most complete list of policy types that are provided by the CMDB Data Manager?

choices.text: Retire, Archive, Attestation, Certification, and Delete

questions.explanation: CMDB Data Manager policy types are Retire, Archive, Delete, Attestation, Certification and Delete CMDB Related Entry. De-duplication is handled by de-duplication tasks/templates and reconciliation by the IRE - neither is a Data Manager policy type. Option A is the only choice listing all five main types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to leverage dynamic reconciliation rules. Which feature must be enabled?
questions.explanation: Dynamic reconciliation rules (largest value, most reported, etc.) can only be created when CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB is enabled. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-reconciliation-rule.html

questions.question: How is the CMDB aligned to business processes?

choices.text: Extends service delivery management to all enterprise departments
Enhances decision-making and operational efficiency across the organization
Enables the CFO/CIO to track software licenses
Provides a centralized view of configuration items and their relationships

questions.explanation: A centralized view of CIs and their relationships supports better decision-making and operational efficiency. License tracking belongs to Software Asset Management. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cnfig-mgmt-and-cmdb.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager needs to ingest third-party CIs into the CMDB. Which method minimizes the risk of technical debt?
questions.explanation: Service Graph Connectors are certified, supported Store integrations kept up to date with partners, so they minimize custom code and technical debt. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-sgc-intro.html

questions.question: What is the relationship between an application and a server?
questions.explanation: Relationship names are read from the parent's side: the Application (parent) 'Runs on' the Server (child) and the Server 'Runs' the Application, i.e. Application > Runs on::Runs > Server. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/manage-tech-servs-domain.html

questions.question: How does a CMDB Administrator use the ServiceNow Platform to ensure the data quality associated with CIs in the CMDB?
questions.explanation: CMDB Workspace is the central place to examine CMDB health and access the CMDB dashboards and governance tools. 'Data Quality Scheduled Job' and 'Data Quality Business Rule' aren't ServiceNow features. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: The ITSM Manager wants to use Technology Management Offerings (Technical Service Offerings) to populate the support group of associated CIs. What CSDM stage would this be completed in?
questions.explanation: Walk adds Technology Management Services, Technology Management Offerings and Dynamic CI groups, so support and technical approval groups can be synchronized onto CIs from the offering. Run adds business services and offerings. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-implement-walk-stage.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager is reviewing the life cycle of CIs to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and relevance. The manager reviews the legacy status values and their equivalent CSDM life cycle stage and life cycle stage status values. Where are these reviewed?
questions.explanation: The Life Cycle Mapping module specifies how legacy status values convert to CSDM life cycle stage / stage status pairs. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-life-cycle-mapping-form.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is using the Duplicate CI Remediator to address a de-duplication task. On the first tab of the wizard, the Main CI is selected. Which attributes are used to identify the Main CI?
questions.explanation: The Duplicate CI Remediator recommends a main CI using criteria such as most related items, most relationships, newest discovered, newest updated and oldest created. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/reconcile-dup-task.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to use the CMDB and CSDM Data Foundations Dashboard. Where can the Administrator obtain the dashboard?

choices.text: It is a free application on the ServiceNow Innovation Lab.
It is a paid application on the ServiceNow Store.
It is a free application on the ServiceNow Store.

questions.explanation: The CMDB and CSDM Data Foundations Dashboards don't require a paid license and are delivered/updated through the ServiceNow Store. Source: ServiceNow University course 'CMDB Fundamentals' (Australia); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/csdm-cmdb-foundations-dashboards.html

questions.question: A Platform Owner is building the governance team to support the CSDM. Drag the domain to the roles that make up the governance team.

targets.label: Service Owner(s), Platform Owner
Technology Service Owner(s), Application Service Owner(s), Platform Owner
Enterprise Architect(s), Platform Owner
Enterprise Architect(s), Data Steward(s), Process Owner(s), Platform Owner

questions.explanation: CSDM 5 personas by domain: Foundation - Process Owner, Data Steward, Product Owner, Contract Manager; Design & Planning - Enterprise Architect, Application Owner; Service Delivery (technical) - service instance / service delivery owners; Manage Portfolio - Service Owners. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/foundation-domain.html

questions.question: An Enterprise Architect needs to help the CMDB owner understand the benefits of CSDM. Drag the CSDM domains to the respective benefits.

targets.label: Understand CIs related to business application and related capabilities, identify redundancies, monitor costs and make better investment decisions around roadmap
Understand technical services, technical service offerings, service support and all relationships to underlying technology CIs
Understand business services and ownership, cost, scope of what to offer to the business/consumer and request access to the business services
Use the base system tables when implementing the CSDM to derive highest value from ServiceNow products and the Now Platform

questions.explanation: Design & Planning: business applications, capabilities and investment decisions; Service Delivery: technical services/offerings and the underlying CIs; Service Consumption: business services and what's offered/requested; Foundation: base-system tables. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/foundation-domain.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator, viewing the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard, notices the Unique Locations Result percentage low. What is the recommended process from the associated playbook to correct this issue?

choices.text: Retain the location that matches the organization's standard naming convention, and delete the duplicate without further validation
Keep both locations as either can be used as a valid alternate location
Review both locations, update CIs with the correct location and delete the duplicate location
Use the Duplicate CI Remediator to merge the duplicate location records

questions.explanation: The Unique Locations metric counts location records whose name is used more than once. The playbook approach is to review both records, repoint CIs to the correct location and then delete the duplicate. Locations aren't CIs, so the Duplicate CI Remediator doesn't apply. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A CMDB Manager wants to start adding CSDM design and planning (design) domain components into the CMDB. Who is involved in this exercise?
questions.explanation: The CSDM 5 white paper names Enterprise Architect and Application Owner as the personas of the Design & Planning domain (business capabilities, business applications, information objects). Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/design-domain.html
